title: Honey Bunny Kidz Story Time: 7 Fun Stories & Songs with Pip Puppy, Dotty Duckling & Lulu Lamb

scenes.title: Honey Bunny Kidz Story Time: 7 Fun Stories & Songs with Pip Puppy, Dotty Duckling & Lulu Lamb
scenes.subtitle: Honey Bunny Kidz  •  Story Time

lines.text: Welcome to Honey Bunny Kidz story time! Today we have 7 stories for you.
Are you ready for the first story? Say, yes!
Yay! It's called: Pip Puppy's Big Leaf Pile. Let's watch!
Honey Bunny Kidz presents: Pip Puppy's Big Leaf Pile! Let's play in the autumn leaves!
It was a cool, sunny autumn day. Mama Bunny took Honey and Pip to the park.
Leaves were falling from the trees, one by one.
Woof! Look! The leaves are dancing down!
Swish, swish! Can you wiggle your fingers like falling leaves?
Wiggle, wiggle, down they go!
Crunch, crunch!
What sound do the leaves make when I step on them?
Crunch, crunch! The leaves are dry and crunchy.
I have a big idea! Let's make the biggest leaf pile ever!
What a fun idea, Pip. A big job is easier when we do it together.
I can do it all by myself! I am super fast!
Pip pushed the leaves together, very fast. Swish, swish, swish!
Look! My leaf pile!
Whoooosh!
Oh! A puff of wind blew the little leaf pile away.
Hey! Come back, leaves! Hee hee!
Hmm. Maybe a big leaf pile needs lots of helpers.
We can help you, Pip! Let's ask our friends.
Quack! Can we help too?
Baa! I love autumn leaves!
Let's all work together. I will use the big rake, and you can carry the leaves.
Yay! Thank you, friends!
I found a leaf! What colour is my leaf?
Red! A red leaf, like a shiny apple.
My leaf is the colour of the sun. What colour is it?
Yellow! A yellow leaf!
My leaf is orange, like a pumpkin.
And my leaf is brown, like a cosy tree trunk.
Red, yellow, orange and brown. Autumn is so colourful!
Look at these leaves. How many can you count?
Let's count together. One, two, three, four, five!
Five leaves! Into the pile they go!
Mama Bunny raked, and the friends carried leaves. The pile grew bigger and bigger. Let's sing the Leaf Pile Song!
Crunch, crunch, leaves on the ground! Red and yellow, falling down!
Rake them up, one, two, three! A big leaf pile for you and me!
Stomp your feet! Crunch, crunch, crunch!
Crunch, crunch, leaves on the ground! Red and yellow, falling down!
Rake them up, one, two, three! A big leaf pile for you and me!
Twirl around like a leaf in the wind!
Wow! Our leaf pile is so big!
Before we jump, let's check. Only soft leaves, no sticks. And a grown-up is always close by.
Who should jump first? Hmm.
Dotty is the smallest. Dotty, you go first!
Thank you, Pip! Quack! Whee!
Crunch!
Then Lulu jumped, and Honey jumped. And then it was Pip's turn. One, two, three, jump!
Crunch!
Where did Pip go? Can you see him?
Here I am! Peekaboo!
Hee hee! You have leaves on your ears, Pip!
You look like a little leafy tree!
Let's be tall trees. Stand up and reach your arms up high.
Now sway in the wind, slow and gentle.
Let your leaves fall down, down, down.
Breathe in the cool autumn air.
And breathe out, nice and slow.
Making the leaf pile was the most fun, because we did it together!
That's right, Pip. When we work together, big jobs are easy and fun.
Then they raked the leaves into a big pile again, so the next friends could play too.
Helping hands make the best leaf piles.
Share with a friend and subscribe to Honey Bunny Kidz!
Woof! Bye-bye, friends! See you next time on Honey Bunny Kidz!

scenes.title: Pip and Mama Bunny's Rainy-Day Fort
scenes.subtitle: A Kids Story  •  Honey Bunny Kidz

lines.text: Honey Bunny Kidz presents: Pip and Mama Bunny's Rainy-Day Fort.
Pitter, patter, pitter, patter. It was a rainy day at Honey Bunny's cosy house.
Oh, rain, rain. I wanted to play in the park today.
Me too, Pip. What can we do inside?
Hmm. I have an idea. Shall we build a cosy blanket fort?
A fort? Yes, please! Woof, woof!
What do you think we need to build a fort?
We need two chairs, one big blanket, and lots of soft pillows!
Pip and I found the pillows. How many pillows can you count?
One, two, three, four! Four soft pillows!
What color is this pillow?
Pink! Pink like my bow.
And this one is blue, this one is yellow, and this one is green.
Mama Bunny held the chairs steady, and Honey and Pip spread the big purple blanket over the top.
Grown-ups help with the chairs, so everything stays safe.
Look! It's not just a fort. It looks like a ship!
A pillow ship! Mama made a sail from an old sheet, and a broom for the mast.
Mama folded a paper hat, too. Guess who wants to be the captain?
Me! Captain Pip, ready to sail!
Captain Pip piled all four pillows on his side of the ship.
Pip, may I have a pillow too? The floor is a little bit hard.
Hmm. But I like all the soft pillows.
What do you think Pip should do?
I know! I can share. One for you, one for me, and two for our friends!
Thank you, Pip! Sharing makes our ship cosy for everyone.
Knock, knock!
Who could that be? It's Dotty Duckling, with tiny raindrops on her feathers.
Quack! Hello, friends! It's too rainy to swim in the pond today.
Come aboard, Dotty! Here is a pillow for you.
Thank you, Captain Pip! What a lovely ship.
Everybody, row your arms with me! Can you row, row, row?
Row and row, here we go, over the waves so soft and slow!
Rock to the left, rock to the right, our pillow ship is snug and bright!
Oh! Here comes a pretend wave! Splish, splash!
I love the pretend sea! What sound does a duck make?
Quack, quack! You got it!
Let's make looking circles with our hands, like a spyglass. Can you look through yours?
I see, I see. Land ho! It's Sofa Island!
Hooray! Let's sail to Sofa Island!
Row, row, row! We're almost there!
Welcome to Sofa Island, sailors! I have apple slices for everyone.
Pip shared the apple slices, too. One for Honey, one for Dotty, one for Mama, and one for Pip.
Look out the window. The rain is getting softer and softer.
Let's take a big, slow ocean breath. Breathe in, like a wave coming in.
And breathe out, like a wave going out. Whoosh.
That was the best rainy day ever. Thank you for sharing the fort with me, friends!
On a rainy day, a blanket, some pillows, and friends who share can make a big adventure.
Share with a friend and subscribe to Honey Bunny Kidz!
Bye-bye, little sailors! See you next time on Honey Bunny Kidz.

scenes.title: Why Doesn't Dotty Duckling Get Wet?
scenes.subtitle: An Animal Fact Story  •  Honey Bunny Kidz

lines.text: Honey Bunny Kidz presents: Why Doesn't Dotty Duckling Get Wet?
Pitter, patter, pitter, patter.
It was a soft, rainy morning. Pitter, patter, went the rain.
Mama, it's raining! Can we go outside and splash?
Yes, little one! But first, what do we wear in the rain? Can you guess?
A raincoat and rain boots! You look ready, Honey.
My coat is yellow, and my boots are red!
Let's hold hands, stay together, and splash in the little puddles.
Down by the pond, they saw Dotty Duckling, paddling happily in the rain.
Quack, quack! Good morning, Honey! I love rainy days!
Dotty, you don't have a raincoat! Aren't you all wet?
Look at my feathers. Are they wet, or dry? What do you think?
They are dry! The raindrops roll right off me!
Wow! But how? Why don't you get wet, Dotty?
Here is my duck secret. Near my tail, I have a tiny spot that makes a special oil.
I rub the oil on my feathers with my beak, like this. Rub, rub, rub!
Special oil? That's so clever!
The oil keeps the water out. So the rain can't soak in. My feathers are waterproof!
See the raindrops on my back? They sit like shiny little beads. Let's count them as they roll off. Ready?
One. Two. Three!
Roll, roll, roll! Off they go!
Splash!
Splash! Here came Pip Puppy, hopping through the puddles.
Hello, friends! Oh, my fur is all drippy!
Pip's fur gets wet, but Dotty's feathers stay dry. Everybody is made in a special way!
Do you know what puppies do when we're wet? Can you guess?
We shake! Shake, shake, shake!
Shake with me! Wiggle your head, wiggle your arms. Shake, shake, shake!
Hee hee! Little drops everywhere!
Mama Bunny wrapped Pip in a soft, warm towel. Next time, Pip will wear his raincoat too.
Now let's jump in the puddles! Stomp your feet with us!
Splish, splash, puddle jump! Stomp, stomp, stomp!
Splash!
Splish, splash, puddle jump! Hop, hop, hop!
Splash!
Splish, splash, one more jump! Quack, quack, quack!
Splash!
What does a duck say? Can you say it, too?
Quack, quack! What a great quack!
Dotty, how do you swim so fast?
Look at my feet! They are wide and flat, like little paddles.
Ducks have webbed feet. There is soft skin between their toes, so they can push the water. Paddle, paddle!
Can you make your hands into duck feet? Paddle, paddle, paddle!
Paddle, paddle! Look, I'm a duck! Quack!
Then the rain went slow, and slower, and stopped. The sun came out to say hello.
Look! A rainbow! What colors can you see?
Red, orange, yellow, green, blue, and purple!
Rain is good for the flowers, good for the pond, and good for little ducks like me!
Let's take a big breath of fresh, rainy-day air. Breathe in, slowly.
And breathe out. Ahhh.
Today I learned a duck secret! Dotty's feathers have special oil, so the rain rolls right off.
And you have a raincoat, Honey! We both stay cosy.
And I have a big shake! Woof!
Everybody is made in a special way. Thank you for splashing with us! See you next time on Honey Bunny Kidz.

scenes.title: Ollie Owl's Animal Sounds Song
scenes.subtitle: A Sing-Along Rhyme  •  Honey Bunny Kidz

lines.text: Honey Bunny Kidz presents: Ollie Owl's Animal Sounds Song! Get ready to sing, and move with us!
The sun was going down. Little lanterns began to glow.
Pip, look! This big tree stump is just like a little stage!
Woof woof! Let's sing the Wiggle Waggle Song again!
Hoo... hoo...
Listen! Who is that? Can you guess who says hoo, hoo?
It was Ollie Owl! He just woke up. Owls wake up when the sun goes down.
Hoo, hoo! Good evening, friends! May I sing with you?
Yes, Ollie! Let's make a new song. Every friend makes a sound, and shows a move!
Then I will be the song leader, up here on the stage. Here is our new chorus!
Everybody, sing with us!
Wiggle, waggle, one, two, three!
Make a sound and sing with me!
Flap and hop and turn around.
Every friend has a special sound!
Me first! Owls say hoo, hoo. And we flap our soft wings.
Ollie Owl says hoo, hoo, hoo.
Flap your wings, the way owls do!
Can you say hoo, hoo, and flap your arms like wings?
Hoo, hoo! Wonderful flapping!
Owls can turn their heads very far. Can you turn your head slowly, this way, and that way?
Baa! Hello, Ollie! May I sing my sound next?
Lulu Lamb says baa, baa, baa.
Bounce up high, then la, la, la!
Can you say baa, like a little lamb?
Baa! Now bounce with me. Boing, boing, boing!
Quack quack! My turn!
Dotty Duckling says quack, quack, quack.
Waddle forward, waddle back!
Can you waddle like a duck? Waddle, waddle!
Woof! Now me!
Pip the Puppy says woof, woof, hey!
Wag your tail and jump to play!
Now, all together!
Wiggle, waggle, one, two, three!
Make a sound and sing with me!
Flap and hop and turn around.
Every friend has a special sound!
Meow! I want to sing too!
Mimi Kitten says meow, meow.
Stretch up tall and take a bow!
Can you say meow, and take a little bow?
Hmm. Everyone has a big sound. But bunnies are very quiet. What is my sound, Ollie?
Hoo, hoo. I have very good ears, Honey. I know two bunny sounds!
Bunnies wiggle their little noses. Sniff, sniff. And bunnies talk with their back feet. Thump, thump!
Thump, thump! I can do that! That is my special sound!
Honey Bunny wiggles her nose.
Thump, thump, thump, and up she goes!
Can you wiggle your nose like a bunny, and stamp your foot? Thump, thump!
Yay! Quiet sounds are special too!
Sing it one more time, little friends!
Wiggle, waggle, one, two, three!
Make a sound and sing with me!
Flap and hop and turn around.
Every friend has a special sound!
Which animal sound is your favorite? Hoo, baa, quack, woof, meow, or thump?
I like them all! Hoo, hoo!
The moon rose high and round. Mama Bunny came to walk the little friends home.
What a lovely song! Before we go, let's do a quiet owl breath.
Breathe in slowly through your nose, and fill up like a fluffy owl.
And breathe out, soft as a feather. Hoo, hoo.
Wiggle, waggle, soft and slow.
Goodnight, friends, it's time to go.
Every friend has a special sound. Loud or quiet, every sound is wonderful!

Hoo, hoo! Goodnight! See you next time on Honey Bunny Kidz!

scenes.title: Lulu Lamb's Big and Small Picnic
scenes.subtitle: Learn Opposites  •  Honey Bunny Kidz

lines.text: Honey Bunny Kidz presents: Lulu Lamb's Big and Small Picnic! Let's play an opposite game together!
It was a bright, sunny morning on Sunny Hill. Mama Bunny brought a picnic basket.
Who wants to help me get our picnic ready?
Me, me! I can help!
I want to help too. But I am so small.
Little Lulu, small friends can be big helpers. Let's play the Big and Small game on the way!
Look, Lulu! Two red balls. One is big, and one is small.
Which ball is big? Can you point to the big ball?
Yes! This ball is big. Big, big, big!
And this ball is small. Small, small, small.
I will carry the small ball. It is just right for me!
And just like that, Lulu was helping.
Then Dotty Duckling came waddling up the hill.
Quack, quack! Hello, friends! Can I come to the picnic?
Yes, Dotty! Look at Mama Bunny and Dotty. Who is small? Can you say it?
Dotty is small! And Mama Bunny is big.
Big or small, there is room for everyone at our picnic.
Let's make our bodies big! Stand up tall, and spread your arms wide!
Now make your body small. Curl up like a little ball.
Quack! That was fun!
Over by the slide, Pip Puppy was playing.
Woof, woof! Look at me! I climbed the ladder, step by step.
Is Pip up high, or down low? What do you think?
Pip is up! Up, up, up high!
Now I sit down and slide down. Wheee!
Now Pip is down! Down, down, down low.
Let's do it too! Reach your paws up, up, up!
Now touch the ground. Down, down, down!
Woof! Up and down is so much fun. Your turn on the slide, Honey!
Then Pip ran to the picnic. Zoom, zoom! Pip was very fast.
I am fast! Zoom, zoom, zoom!
Wait, Pip! Stop, please! Look down, by your paw.
It was a tiny snail, on the stepping stone path.
Hello, little snail. Is the snail fast, or slow? Can you guess?
The snail is slow. Slow, slow, slow.
Oh! I did not see the little snail. Thank you, Lulu. I will walk slowly here.
I am small, so I can see small things!
Pip waited, and the little snail went slowly on its way.
Lulu, you were a big helper today!
Thank you, Mama Bunny! Let's sing the Big and Small song. Do the moves with me!
Big, big, stretch up tall!
Small, small, curl up small!
Up, up, reach the sky!
Down, down, touch the ground!
Fast, fast, wiggle your feet!
Slow, slow, like a snail so sweet!
Big and small, short and tall,
we are friends, one and all!
Everyone sat down for the picnic. The little snail rested in the warm sun.
Let's take a calm breath together. Breathe in, big and slow.
And breathe out, small and soft.
What was your favourite? Big or small, up or down, fast or slow?
I like them all!
Big or small, everyone can help, and everyone is special.

scenes.title: Lulu Lamb's Sleepy Animal Stretches
scenes.subtitle: A Bedtime Story  •  Honey Bunny Kidz

lines.text: Honey Bunny Kidz presents: Lulu Lamb's Sleepy Animal Stretches.
It was almost bedtime. The moon peeked in the window, and the stars began to twinkle.
But Honey Bunny was still hopping! Hop, hop, hop!
Mama, my legs are so wiggly! I can't stop hopping!
You had a busy, happy day, little one. Now your body needs help to slow down.
What do you think helps a wiggly body feel calm? Hmm?
A slow, sleepy stretch! And look who came to help.
Lulu Lamb and Mimi Kitten were visiting with their mamas, who were having tea in the kitchen.
Baa! Hello, Honey! We know the best sleepy stretches!
Animal stretches! Meow! Do you want to try?
Yes, please!
Everybody, find a soft mat. Pink, green, or blue. Which color mat would you pick?
I pick the green one! I'm ready!
First, the kitty stretch! Get on your hands and knees, like a kitty cat.
Now push your back up high, like a round, round hill. Up, up, up.
Then let your tummy sink down slowly, and look up at the stars.
Up like a hill, and down like a bowl! That feels nice!
Let's do it three times. One. Two. Three.
Can you make a kitty sound? What does a kitten say?
Meow! Soft and sleepy. Meow.
My turn! This one is called the sleepy sheep.
Sit back on your heels, and curl up small, like a soft, woolly ball.
Rest your head down. Now rock gently. Side to side. Side to side.
I'm a tiny, fluffy cloud!
Can you curl up small, like a sleepy sheep? Let's try together.
Baa. So cosy.
Hoo-hoo!
Who says hoo-hoo, at the window? Can you guess?
It's me, Ollie Owl! Good evening, friends! May I show you my owl stretch?
Open your arms wide, like big owl wings. Flap them slowly. Flap, and flap.
Now turn your head gently. This way, and that way. Owls look all around.
Slow wings make me feel so calm.
Now I have one! It's the bunny breath!
Bunnies sniff, sniff, sniff with their little noses. Then one long breath out. Ahh.
Let's do it together. Sniff, sniff, sniff. And blow out slowly. Ahh.
How many sniffs did we do? Can you count them?
Three sniffs! One, two, three!
My body feels soft and slow now.
The moon smiled down, and the friends sang a sleepy stretch song.
Stretch up high, touch the sky. Wave hello to the moon so bright!
Kitty arch, and sheep curl small.
Owl wings flap, and that is all!
Can you reach up high with us? Stretch, stretch, stretch!
Stretch up high, touch the sky. Goodnight, goodnight, sleep tight!
What a lovely, sleepy song. Goodnight, little stretchers.
Then Lulu and Mimi waved goodbye, and went home with their mamas.
How does your body feel now, Honey?
Not wiggly anymore. Just sleepy.
Which stretch did you like best? The kitty, the sheep, the owl, or the bunny?
I liked them all!
Let's take one more bunny breath. Sniff, sniff, sniff. And ahh.
And Honey Bunny drifted off to sleep, cosy and calm.
When your body feels wiggly, try a sleepy animal stretch, and a slow, soft breath.
Share with a friend and subscribe to Honey Bunny Kidz!
Goodnight, little one. Sweet dreams, and see you next time on Honey Bunny Kidz.

scenes.title: Ollie Owl Helps Find Mimi's Bell
scenes.subtitle: Bedtime Story  •  Honey Bunny Kidz

lines.text: Honey Bunny Kidz presents: Ollie Owl Helps Find Mimi's Bell! A cosy bedtime story.
The sun went down, and the stars came out. Mimi Kitten had played with Honey all afternoon.
Now Mama Bunny was walking Mimi home for bed.
Oh! My collar is so quiet. Where is my little bell?
Your jingly bell is gone?
Yes. I feel a little worried. I love my bell.
It's okay to feel worried, Mimi. When we need help, we can ask a friend.
Who has the best ears at night? Can you guess?
Ollie Owl! Owls can hear tiny sounds in the dark.
Hoo-hoo! Hello, friends. Did somebody call me?
Ollie, can you help me? My little bell is lost.
Of course I can help. Owls have very good ears. Let's all be very quiet, and listen.
Shh. Everyone listened.
Chirp, chirp, chirp!
Is that the jingle? What makes that sound?
It's a little cricket! Not a bell.
The little cricket sang in the grass. Then they heard another sound.
Ribbit, ribbit!
Who says ribbit? Can you say it with me?
A frog! Ribbit! That was funny. But it is not my bell.
Mimi, let's think. Where did you have your bell today?
I had my bell at nap time. I curled up in my cosy bed.
Hoo! Then let's go and listen by your cosy bed.
We'll all go together. I'll walk you home, Mimi.
So Mama Bunny walked Mimi and Honey to Mimi's cottage, and Ollie flew softly beside them.
Mimi's room was warm and cosy. Her round bed had a soft pink cushion.
Shh. Let's listen very, very carefully.
I will pat my blanket. Pat, pat, pat.
Jingle, jingle!
Did you hear that? What made that sound?
A jingle! It's Mimi's bell!
There it was! The little bell was snuggled in Mimi's blanket, all along.
My bell! It was in my bed the whole time!
Hoo-hoo! We found it together.
Thank you, Ollie. Thank you, Honey and Mama. I don't feel worried any more.
When you feel worried, it's good to ask for help. Friends help each other.
Mama Bunny put the bell back on Mimi's pink collar.
Jingle!
Now my collar sings again! But shh, it's sleepy time.
Before bed, let's do a sleepy kitten stretch together.
Can you stretch your arms up high, like a kitten?
Now a big, slow kitten yawn. Aaah.
Smell the flower. Breathe in.
Blow the candle. Breathe out.
One more time. Breathe in, and breathe out.
Mimi curled up in her cosy bed, with her little bell safe and sound.
Goodnight, Mimi. Goodnight, Ollie. Goodnight, little friends.
Who helped Mimi find her bell? Can you remember?
Her friends did! When you need help, you can ask a friend.
Mama Bunny and Honey waved goodnight, and went home to bed too.
